The specified sequential element matching has \(8{,}099\) pairs and leaves one critical \(0\)-cell and \(36\) critical \(10\)-cells; the complete matched Hasse orientation is acyclic on all \(112{,}924\) cover relations. Forman discrete Morse theory therefore yields \(\Delta_3(H)\simeq\bigvee^{36}S^{10}\). Independent exact mod-\(2\) boundary ranks give reduced Betti number \(36\) only in degree \(10\).

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is a canonical symmetric cubic incidence graph, and ordinary cut complexes are a central construction in the cited foundational paper. This case sharpens the published general top-two-degree homology bound to a complete homotopy type and provides a concrete comparison with the distinct total-cut construction. The finite invariant is natural, not an arbitrary slice, and the exact acyclic-Morse reduction is reusable as a benchmark for further cubic or incidence-graph cut-complex calculations.
